item.title: No white lines painted on pavement, 13th November
item.description:
There is a white box for pavement parking painted on the right side of Ridgeway West but not the left side. Many vans park on this corner which makes it tight for the bin lorry and emergency vehicles to pass through. Is it possible to paint a white box on the pavement on the left hand side as you drive into Ridgeway West DA15 to stop this happening?

item.title: Lights reported as not working. Still not fixed, 13th November
item.description:
Re W/O Ref 11883708/1 Target date was confirmed by email for 6/11/26. Still not fixed. Stairwell and walk through from Lucey way to Rail Sidings Rd ,lights not working. Garages/service rd between Rail sidings rd and Dockley Rd , lights not working. This presents a potentially dangerous environment for the vulnerable and elderly. It also presents opportunity for antisocial behaviour and potential damage to, and theft from the garages and cars. Problem ongoing for almost three weeks now and is a reoccurring problem. Southwark council have a duty to ensure safe environment.
